summary: The one-line change makes the backup-password email input editable when the authenticated account has no email, while preserving read-only behavior when an email exists and leaving skip controls intact. Server-side password registration already attaches email and password for no-email accounts.

evidence: `requireBackupPassword` now sets `emailInput.readOnly` to `Boolean(emailInput.value)`, so empty-email accounts can type an email and the existing visibility check shows the email field.
Accounts with an existing email still get `readOnly` true and the email field hidden.
`handlePasswordRegister` calls `attachEmailAndPassword` for a hub user without email, so the entered email and matching backup password are saved.
`skipPasswordField` remains visible in the backup flow and `skipBackup` remains wired to `/api/auth/password/skip`.
